study type: Descriptive study of a prospective cohort
exposure: serial measurements of pregnancy weight gain
duration of stages and phases of labour
outcome: reference curves for umbilical cord pH
cohort: The Stockholm-Gotland Perinatal Cohort (SGPC) is a prospectively collected, population-based cohort that includes all births (from 22 completed gestational weeks onwards) between 1 January 2008 and 15 June 2020 in the Stockholm and Gotland regions of Sweden, comprising 335,153 singleton and 11,025 multiple pregnancies.
finding: The SGPC is a unique cohort providing highly detailed, time-varying medical record data throughout pregnancy, delivery, and postpartum for both mother and infant, enabling high-quality perinatal studies previously not possible due to its rich content and linkages to national registers.
